decision.rationale: Standalone sub-quadrum Japanese rainy season gameplay on four AMJ biomes cannot be achieved by vanilla, broad-season mutating mod, optional visuals or large content framework without substantial unrelated replacement; use positive-weight postfix preserving engine restrictions and common weather identity.
decision.independent_gap: Japan-specific June/July Tsuyu and September/October Akisame recurring weather tendencies at calendar-day resolution, restricted to AMJE biome scope without rewriting other mod biomes or forcing extra events.
